# Make Me a Hanzi dictionary

Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi

Pinned revision: `bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92`

`dictionary.txt` is redistributed under LGPL-3.0-or-later according to the upstream `COPYING` file. It is converted into one JSON file per character at build time, without changing its fields. The stroke graphics remain separately packaged from `hanzi-writer-data` under the Arphic Public License.
